fee_notes: Royalty minimum is $500/month for months 1-12, then $1,000/month thereafter. Marketing Fund Contribution is flat $2,500/month (adjusted for inflation up to 5%/year). Tech fee is $2,000/month for first 5 users plus $75/month per additional user. Local advertising $1,000/month required until 80+ clients.
raw_excerpt: Royalty: A monthly fee equal to the greater of a Monthly Minimum Royalty Fee ($500 during months 1-12, $1,000 every month thereafter), or 6% of your Gross Revenues. Marketing Fund Contribution $2,500 monthly. Technology Fee Currently $2,000 per month for the first five (5) users, and an additional $75/month for each additional user after the fifth.
